challengeList.rules:
# **Main Rules**

- You must complete Poppy Playtime Chapter 1 & and Chapter 2 (in that order) on **current patch** using the Any% ruleset for each chapter as listed below!
- All runs must have game audio
- Runs must be on the PC version of the game

- Runs can not have more than 5 minutes of inactivity.

- Usage of FPS capping tools or CPU/GPU heating tools is banned.

- Capping your FPS to more than 120 is not allowed.
- Also note that if you’re used to running on older versions, some skips will work differently on current patch. Please check out some of these guides for assistance

# **Autosplitter**

- Runs that pause or load and do not have a timer showing IGT will be timed using RTA.
- Please note that the timer will run while transitioning between chapters, feel free to pause manually - but this will be retimed during verification regardless.

- To set up the autosplitter to support both chapters **please follow along with this guide (Coming Soon)**

# **Chapter 1 Any%**

- Timer starts on first player movement or first camera movement

- Timer ends on black screen (when screen starts pulsing black)

# **Chapter 2 Any%**

- Timer will already be running, but for the purposes of retiming the time will resume upon the first player or camera movement

- Time ends when the lever is pulled to stop the train.

- If the train lever pull isn't shown, run must show up until the credits start playing.

- Replacing the tapes for the introduction to Musical Memory, Wack-a-Wuggy, and Statues is banned.

- Usage of train code printer is allowed.

- Time starts on first movement or first camera movement.

categories.name: PC
categories.rules:
### PC Rules:

- Runs that pause and/or load, and don't have a timer showing LRT will be timed using RTA.
- Autosplitter and Load Remover setup guide (read the note under the video): https://www.speedrun.com/ppt_c1/guides/qi1kr

__ __

categories.name: Mobile
categories.rules:
### Mobile Rules:

- Runs are done on the iOS or Android version of the game.
- Runs must be performed on the newest available patch of the game.
- Loads and pauses are manually retimed by moderators.
- Don't cover the loading icon in the top left of the screen otherwise the run will be only RTA retimed.
- Please stay still and look at the gates while the game is loading, if it's too hard to determine when the gates open, run will be only RTA retimed.

__ __

categories.name: Console
categories.rules:
### Console Rules:

- Runs are done on the PS4/PS5, Xbox One/Series X or Nintendo Switch versions of the game.
- Runs must be performed on the newest available patch of the game.
- Loads and pauses are manually retimed by moderators.
- Playing with a keyboard and mouse on console is banned.

__ __

values.name: No Major Glitches (NMG)
values.rules:
### NMG Rules:

- Finish the game without using any major glitches. List of banned glitches in the NMG category: https://www.speedrun.com/ppt_c1/resources/l1esx

*See Game Rules for Universal Rules.*

values.name: All Tapes NMG
values.rules:
### All Tapes NMG Rules:

- Finish the game without using any major glitches. List of banned glitches in the NMG category: https://www.speedrun.com/ppt_c1/resources/l1esx
- Collect and place all 5 VHS tapes into their respective tape player.

*See Game Rules for Universal Rules.*

values.name: Any%

- Runs that are eligible for NMG will be moved to NMG.

values.name: All Tapes

- Runs that are eligible for NMG will be moved to NMG.

categories.name: PC
categories.rules:
### PC Rules:

- Runs that pause and/or load, and don't have a timer showing LRT will be timed using RTA.
- Autosplitter and Load Remover setup guide (read the note under the video): https://www.speedrun.com/ppt_c1/guides/qi1kr

__ __

categories.name: Mobile
categories.rules:
### Mobile Rules:

- Runs are done on the iOS or Android version of the game.
- Runs must be performed on the newest available patch of the game.
- Loads and pauses are manually retimed by moderators.
- Don't cover the loading icon in the top left of the screen otherwise the run will be only RTA retimed.
- Please stay still and look at the gates while the game is loading, if it's too hard to determine when the gates open, run will be only RTA retimed.

__ __

games.name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 1
games.rules:
### Universal Rules:

- Timer starts on first player or camera movement.
- Timer ends when the screen starts pulsing black after opening Poppy's case.
- Runs that claim to be Top 10 in any category must have game audio.
- Runs can't have more than 5 minutes of inactivity.
- Any modifications to the game are banned [changing the in-game tapes is the only exception].

- Finish the game without using any major glitches. List of banned glitches in the NMG category: https://www.speedrun.com/ppt_c1/resources/l1esx
- Collect and place all 5 VHS tapes into their respective tape player.

*See Game Rules for Universal Rules.*
